recommendation: Keep the commit as a narrow source fix completing the published FHIR-16861 correction. No separate FHIR-28499 decision is needed here because that issue only explains the copied TerminologyCapabilities location for this wording.
issue_request: FHIR-16861 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 vocabulary issue asking to update the Terminology Bindings wording for codeSystem-Content because 'How much of the content...' was confusing and could imply a quantity rather than an extent of representation.
initial_application: The issue was initially applied by SVN revision 14733, represented by git commit e3e436ef84433dfd4b6472d5e1435ef6d7a86de1, which changed the old spreadsheet wording from 'How much...' to 'The extent...' but left the phrase as 'The extent ... are represented'. Later source refactors carried that wording into the current XML source, and no prior combined-branch reconciliation commit existed for FHIR-16861.
additional_context: CodeSystem and TerminologyCapabilities are active current-build resources in source/fhir.ini. FHIR-28499 later added TerminologyCapabilities.codeSystem.content using the CodeSystem.content definition and binding description, which made the same wording appear there too. Related Jira searches found no later final decision that superseded the wording correction, and quoted Zulip/Confluence searches found no conflicting community context.
reconciliation: Changed the active CodeSystem definition, CodeSystemContentMode binding/value set/code system descriptions, the copied TerminologyCapabilities content definition/binding description, and their companion SVG title text from the old or partially-applied wording to 'The extent to which the content of the code system (the concepts and codes it defines) is represented...'.
source_changes: source/codesystem/structuredefinition-CodeSystem.xml: Corrected CodeSystem.content definition and CodeSystemContentMode binding description to use singular 'is represented' with clearer 'extent to which' phrasing.
source/codesystem/valueset-codesystem-content-mode.xml: Corrected the value set description for the CodeSystem content-mode binding.
source/codesystem/codesystem-codesystem-content-mode.xml: Corrected the code system description for the CodeSystem content-mode binding.
source/terminologycapabilities/structuredefinition-TerminologyCapabilities.xml: Kept the copied CodeSystem content-mode definition and binding description synchronized with the CodeSystem wording.

source/codesystem/codesystem.svg and source/terminologycapabilities/terminologycapabilities.svg: Updated companion diagram title text so checked-in diagrams no longer show the old or partially-applied wording.

related_jiras.note: Published issue adding TerminologyCapabilities.codeSystem.content and instructing editors to use the CodeSystem.content definition and description, explaining why the copied wording was fixed in TerminologyCapabilities too.
